data.body: [P2] Preserve incomplete markers across scoped refreshes. A failed refresh can cache a victim's retry while failing to read its original invocation record. A subsequent successful `for_item(peer)` reads only the peer but passes the entire event cache into `_bind_requests`, binding the victim's cached retry as its original request and clearing `binding_deferred`. Reading the original later triggers the chronology error, leaving an immutable incorrect binding. Track incompleteness per marker across calls, and only bind or clear deferral after that marker's own listing and reads complete. Add a regression covering a failed victim refresh followed by a successful peer-only refresh.
